answer: We establish that the spectral expansion of the trust graph isolates adversarial regions through personalized EigenTrust attenuation, restricting propagation to a local spiral of high-connectivity honest nodes. By binding identity to a staking collateral mechanism enforced by zero-knowledge verifiable delays, any malicious sparrow attempting to forge multiple identities incurs severe slashing penalties. This economic barrier creates an ocean of negative expected utility, driving the system to a robust Nash equilibrium where Sybil attacks are unviable.
